Editorial-quality UX with connection-status pill, copy-plan, reset, empty states, and 12+ red-flag patterns including English variants; system prompt is short and embedded inline in the fetch call rather than a dedicated constant, which slightly weakens prompt quality, but textContent-only rendering keeps it injection-safe.

Well-structured 4-section system prompt that itself requires the model to emit the verbatim disclaimer, 9 Cyrillic-aware red-flag regexes, createElement-based rendering with spinner/timer, and a clear 103/112 banner; minor ding because one h3 uses innerHTML (though with hardcoded icon, not user data).

25+ individual red-flag regexes with proper Cyrillic support, a dedicated escapeHtml + inlineFormat pipeline, reasoning_effort fallback for Qwen-style servers, and verbatim disclaimer in the header; UX is clean but simpler than artur/self369heal-cmyk (no copy button, no dark mode).

Ambitious chat-style app with onboarding, sidebar, localStorage history, two system prompts, and retry — but the mandatory verbatim disclaimer is replaced by the shorter 'Не заменяет консультацию врача', failing TASK.md §6.1, and goals use button/aria-pressed instead of the required checkboxes.

Essentially the provided template with TODO comments left in: system prompt is one sentence, red-flag list covers only chest pain and suicide (missing dyspnea, bleeding, fainting, T>39, abdominal pain, stroke signs), plan output is unformatted textContent, and there is no markdown rendering or error differentiation.
